summary: Full iteration-2 test of nearbyok.com (auth, admin, favorites, reviews, owner submissions, 20x32 matrix). 25/25 pytest backend tests PASS. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: home (20 categories, 32 cities, Free-Listing + Login header), admin login (wrong pwd rejected, correct pwd loads dashboard with all stat cards, top-businesses-table, 20-row ingest matrix, submissions list), account page (cookie-based login shows account-user-name + saved/listings/reviews tabs), business detail (google-source-badge, reviews-list, save toggle, review submission), /list-your-business (submitted new business → listing-success → view page shows unverified-badge), matrix pages /hvac/colorado/denver + /bakeries/massachusetts/boston render seed cards, logged-out save-btn correctly redirects to auth.emergentagent.com. Google ingest background job actively running (95/639 done at test time).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> elements (from a Visual-Editor wrapper on dynamic array items). Not user-visible but pollutes console. Wrap dynamic option label in {c.name} without span, or exclude <option> children from ve wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 884 lines — well over the 700-line split threshold. Split into modules: routes/admin, routes/owner_submissions, routes/user, google_ingest, seed.
Still using deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown. Migrate to lifespan context manager.
Frontend hydration warning: <span> children rendered inside <option> tags (AdminIngest, ListBusiness). React 18/19 flags this and it may become an error in future versions.
auth.py stores sessions with expires_at as ISO string — get_current_user has to reparse it. Consider storing as native BSON date for indexable expiry queries + TTL index.
No TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at; expired sessions accumulate forever.
test_credentials: Admin: nearbyok-admin-2026 (header X-Admin-Key or /api/auth/admin-login). Test user created directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md — cleaned up after test.
seed_data_creation: Backend test suite creates its own test user (mongo) per module and cleans up. Frontend test used fe-test-user-1 / fe_test_session_1 and was cleaned up post-run. One submitted business ('FE Test Biz' in denver/plumbers) was created and left as an approved submission; it was NOT cleaned up but is prefixed 'FE Test' — main agent may wish to purge.
